subject: ClearVista: Post-signature transfer — ops readiness, timeline & risks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearvista.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: ClearVista — Post-signature transfer: implementation scope & target dates

Team —

Thanks again — ClearVista signed last Friday ($1.2M ARR; Redwood Dedicated, private deployment in us-east-1). I wanted to capture the key constraints and get CS + implementation lined up so we hit the July 15 go-live target. High-level summary: 

- Contract & billing: SOW_v1 attached (still pending final signature on appendix B for professional services). PO expected from procurement; Neha is driving.
- Customer ask: HIPAA-compliant deployment with 12 months audit log retention, SAML SSO, SCIM, and ability to run inference behind their VPC with egress restrictions.
- Performance target: 99th percentile <250ms for standard text generation; tolerance for longer tails during nightly batch jobs.
- Data: Customer will provide redacted training/test payloads for validation (estimated 20GB total).
- Resources: They can commit 2 backend engineers (integration) + 1 security SME for the initial 6-week onboarding.

Open items for the team:
1) Confirm CS owner and implementation lead (requested kickoff week: May 18).
2) Verify staging cluster/credentials and test dataset transfer method (S3 presigned URLs or SCP).
3) SOC2 / security evidence to share with ClearVista (SOC2 Type II + network diagram + data flow).
4) Finalize deployment runbook and acceptance criteria (attach MAP & SOW drafts).

Ask: Marissa/Vivek — can you take ownership of the onboarding cadence? If we can lock a May 18 10:00am PT kickoff that gives us 8 weeks of runway for readiness plus buffer. I’ll be on the kickoff to represent account context and commercial questions.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(j) 415-555-0191
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearvista.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista — Post-signature transfer: implementation scope & target dates

Thanks Jordan — looping in details and assigning owners.

Quick ack: we’ll take this on. High-level assignment: 
- Marissa Cole: CS lead / success plan owner (overall timeline, adoption metrics, escalation point).
- Vivek Kulkarni: Implementation lead (infra, SSO/SCIM, staging, runbook).

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Kickoff: Tue May 18, 10:00am PT — I’ll send an invite (30-45m).
- Pre-kickoff deliverables (due May 17): draft onboarding runbook, initial acceptance criteria, list of required customer artifacts (SAML metadata, test dataset format, PO).
- Vivek: can you confirm staging cluster availability and whether we need a dedicated staging subnet per the private deployment?

Risks I want on the radar:
- Procurement timeline (if PO slips >2 weeks it will push the infra provisioning window).
- SAML metadata / IdP configuration — some customers require IdP testing time with their SSO vendor.
- Data handling: if the delivered test payloads are PHI we’ll need the signed BAA before ingestion to any shared environment.

I’ll prepare a 1-page onboarding plan (Miro + PDF) and attach the initial sprint plan. Neha — please paste the current procurement contact and PO ETA in thread.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearvista.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista — Implementation checklist + preliminary risk triage

Adding an implementation-first checklist here so we have a concrete kickoff agenda. I attached a lightweight sprint plan (onboarding-sprint-plan.xlsx).

Implementation checklist (first pass) — items and owners:
- Provision dedicated pool in us-east-1 (Infra) — Owner: Infra team / Vivek — ETA: May 24 (blocked on PO for reserved capacity).
- Staging workspace + test credentials — Owner: Vivek — ETA: May 25. Need: S3 presigned or SFTP details from ClearVista.
- SSO (SAML) integration testing — Owner: Vivek & customer security SME — ETA: June 2 (test window scheduling required).
- SCIM user sync validation — Owner: CS (Marissa) & Eng (Vivek) — ETA: June 9.
- Performance validation (load test + 99p latency) — Owner: Performance Eng — ETA: June 21.
- Acceptance sign-off criteria doc (functional + security) — Owner: Marissa — ETA: June 25.

Known dependencies/risks:
- PO delay -> infra provisioning slip (mitigation: temporary trial nodes with limited capacity).
- If customer requires on-prem connectors for PHI in addition to private deployment, timeline extends by 3-4 weeks.

Action items for pre-kickoff:
1) Jordan: confirm final SOW appendix B signature timeline.
2) Neha: send procurement PO contact and expected PO date.
3) Alicia / ClearVista: confirm who will be on the kickoff from your side (roles + emails).
4) Marissa: prepare the adoption KPIs (DAU/latency thresholds/acceptance checklist).

I’ll drop an initial runbook draft into the shared Drive and include a staging-access checklist.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearvista.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearvista.com>, David Liu <david.liu@clearvista.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista — Post-signature transfer: implementation scope & target dates

Hi team — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from our side: 

- Procurement: PO routing is in progress; procurement@clearvista.com should have the latest draft SOW and will confirm the PO date by EOD Monday May 17.
- Security evidence: we need SOC2 Type II report, network diagram, and our security team will request a short questionnaire (I can send this after kickoff). Can you confirm retention settings for logs and whether logs will be accessible to the customer via S3?
- Resources: I’ll confirm our two integration engineers (names to follow) and our security SME on Monday. They’re available for the May 18 kickoff window (10:00am PT works).
- Data: the payloads we send will be de-identified but may contain limited PHI markers; we have a signed BAA attached to the contract — I will re-upload.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director of Product Operations | ClearVista Health
(alicia.gomez@clearvista.com)

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista — Post-signature transfer: implementation scope & target dates

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation before kickoff on Tuesday: 

- Kickoff invite: May 18, 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent — includes Zoom link and agenda).
- Owners: Marissa (CS), Vivek (Implementation), Neha (Procurement/commercial).
- Pre-kickoff deliverables due: May 17 (runbook draft, PO status, SAML metadata if available).
- Attachments: I’ve uploaded SOW_v1 and the Mutual Action Plan to the HubSpot deal record and Drive link in the invite.

If any of the owners want to add items to the kickoff agenda (eg. compliance deep-dive), please reply-all and I’ll slot it. Looking forward to a smooth transfer.

Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
